rules.description: Local shell commands are allowed — safe for testing
Dev shell commands require approval — risky but recoverable
Production shell is blocked — too risky to auto-approve
Read-only git pull is safe across all environments
Read-only git fetch is safe across all environments
Git checkout modifies working tree — requires approval to prevent accidental overwrites
Git push requires approval in all environments — modifies remote state
Direct subprocess execution always requires approval
Catch-all: anything in production requires approval
